product.name: Monoprice Compact 2‑Port 45W GaN Charger with Dual Fast‑Charging USB‑C Ports For Laptop Tablets and Phones
product.description: Monoprice™Compact 2‑Port 45W GaN Charger with Dual Fast‑Charging USB‑C® Ports: For Laptop, Tablets, and PhonesMulti‑Device Fast Charging from a Single Compact Charger Powered by GaN TechnologyThe Monoprice™ Compact 2‑Port 45W GaN Charger with dual USB‑C® ports is an all‑in‑one powerhouse that charges multiple devices. With USB Power Delivery technology, the Type‑C® port supplies up to 45W. When used by itself as a single port output, this unit allows you to charge notebook computers (like the latest MacBook Air® laptop) from 0 to 72% within an hour, a standard mobile phone from 0 to 55% in 30 minutes. Moreover, simultaneously fast charge up to 2 smaller devices (like the iPhone® & iPad® phone and tablet) and go from 0 to 50% power in 30 minutes. GaN technology increases power efficiency while shrinking the circuit size, providing a compact architecture perfect for fitting into small spaces or taking with you on the go. The folding prong design is there for easy travel‑friendly packing. To ensure the best possible performance, we put our chargers through rigorous 3rd party labroatory testing to ensure the performance and protection from overheating, overcharging, excessive current, and short circuits work for you as they are designed to.Single USB‑C port supplies up to 45W for fast charging laptops (like the latest MacBook Air laptop).Dual port for fast charging a mobile phone and tablet together.Small and Travel Friendly: features a folding prong design and a compact size enabled by GaN technology, perfect for tight spaces and travel.Universal compatibility: regardless of brand or manufacturer, this charger is compatible with over 1,000 USB‑powered devices.Tested and certified via independent ETL‑certified laboratories to ensure safety. HIGH POWER, FAST CHARGINGSingle USB‑C port supplies up to 45W, enough for charging laptops but can also be used to charge tablets or phones as only proper amount of power will be drawn by device. ONE CHARGER, MORE DEVICESDual ports supply up to 25W & 20W for fast charging tablets or phones simultaneously. TINY CHARGER PACKING A HUGE AMOUNT OF POWERGaN technology enables a tremendous increase in operating efficiency while shrinking the circuit size. Packing a huge amount of power in the smallest charger of its kind on the market today. With the folding prong design, you have a charger that is perfect for both tight spaces and travel.    UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITYThis charger is universally compatible with USB‑powered devices‑like laptops, tablets, and phones‑with over 1,000 products, regardless of manufacturer or brand. FOLDING PRONGSEquipped with folding prongs, this already small charger becomes even smaller, making it extremely travel‑friendly.
